stats.source: GOB 14 packs a self WhenEnabled 1, instant ValueFunction 4 Current Inner Strength modifier; STA 0xc40001af identifies a caster IS boost.
stats.runtime: CombatSpecials.Landed reaches AwakenedPowerShot.Landed only after target admission and successful landing. Its separate source sample restores caster Inner Strength up to MaxInnerStrength and publishes the actual amount and caster FX.
stats.test: AwakenedPowerShotTests checks the cap, no change at cap or for a dead caster, and the source bounds and level-shaped center. The disposable ability-parity-awakened-power-shot mode exercises a full target request, actual health and IS updates, separate effect IDs and the 60 s reuse.
